provenance.paper_title: SpaceMind: A Modular and Self-Evolving Embodied Vision-Language Agent Framework for Autonomous On-orbit Servicing

representation_paths.memory_component: persistent learned skill files for embodied servicing

evidence.paraphrase: Post-episode RGB, LiDAR, trajectory, and outcome evidence is distilled into learned skill files containing intent, triggers, rules, constraints, evidence, and provenance; the files are loaded for later episodes.
Complete multimodal servicing trajectories and outcomes are distilled into concise reusable skill rules.
The evolution module can create, overlay, rewrite, disable, or leave unchanged a learned skill file, subject to a quality gate.
After each deployed episode, verified multimodal outcomes mutate persistent skill triggers, constraints, and rules; accepted skill files are loaded and selected during subsequent episodes.

adjudication_notes: Strict T3 is supported because post-episode feedback changes a reusable persistent skill artifact after deployment, and later embodied episodes retrieve the revised artifact without resetting it.
